credit: Tips summarized from Mark Rober's video 'I Solved Every Board Game'

games.name: Guess Who
tips: Each question should knock out roughly half the characters still in play. Asking whether the name starts with A–M is one way to do that.
Keep halving the board and a win usually takes five or six questions.

games.name: Rock Paper Scissors
tips: Open a surprise round with rock. Someone answering in a rush most often throws scissors.
In a longer match, the person who just won tends to repeat, and the person who lost tends to step forward: rock, then paper, then scissors. Throw whatever beats the move that just won.

games.name: Coin toss
tips: Use a wobble flip. Tilt your wrist about 45° as you let go so the coin wobbles instead of tumbling, and the face that started up stays up.

games.name: Connect Four
tips: Take the center column. Every winning line except a vertical one passes through it.
Build a beak: a two-way trap, so that when one four-in-a-row gets blocked the other is already there.

games.name: Battleship
tips: Shoot in a checkerboard. Every ship covers at least one of those squares.
After a hit, check up, down, left, and right to find the ship's direction, then sink it.
Once the 2-length ship is gone, spread the remaining shots out to every third square.
Favor the middle of the largest area you still haven't searched. That's where ships are most likely to be.

games.name: Tic-Tac-Toe
tips: Go first and take a corner.
If your opponent leaves the center open, keep taking corners until you create two threats at once.
If they take the center, take the opposite corner.

games.name: Jenga
tips: Poke a block before you commit, and only pull the loose ones. Heights vary by about 1 mm, so some blocks are already free.
Test again every turn. As the tower leans, a different set of blocks loosens.
If a block sticks, give it one quick firm tap instead of dragging it out slowly.
In the endgame, count the safe moves left and leave your opponent an even number.

games.name: Monopoly
tips: Play by the official rules: no Free Parking jackpot, and auction a property immediately when someone passes on it.
Buy nearly everything you land on. You can mortgage it later.
Get to three houses fast. That step is the biggest jump in rent.
Target the oranges. Jail is the most-landed-on square, and the oranges sit 6, 8, and 9 spaces past it.
Pay to get out of Jail early in the game, but stay in later.
Make fair trades.
